'''''688''''' was the designation to a pair of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvettes]] that were part of [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were part of a major convoy passing through the [[Almaran system]] carrying [[Trooper/Legends|troops]]. They were inspected by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing]] that was part of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] as part of their [[Mission to Almaran|mission]] to scan all [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ships to gauge their strength and to destroy any freighters carrying [[Warhead/Legends|Warheads]] to buy time for the Alliance.
